items.title: Actual proximal Gaussian oracle with genuine centered Laplace domain

items.statement: Produce a measurable exact proximal selector p satisfying p+eta*gradientV(p)=y, the genuine quantitative quadratic minimum and uniqueness, and fixed-eta nonexpansivity. The literal Gaussian gradient evaluator G(s,z)=gradientV(p(s)+sqrt(eta(s))*z) is jointly measurable and obeys input/noise Lipschitz constants 1 and sqrteta for equal eta. Produce an actual Markov kernel K(s)=stdGaussian.map(G(s,-)). This covers the exact evaluator (3.2) and only Lemma4.2 (4.4)-(4.5), with no posterior or finite-query claim. Additionally id is genuinely Bochner integrable under every K_s, and exp(t*inner(a,w-int v dK_s)) is integrable under K_s for every vector a and real signed t. This centers at the actual output mean, and proves only the necessary domain for4.3, not its sharp MGF bound.
assumptions: Source beta=1, alpha=kappa^-1, real kappa>=1; actual C2 V with kappa^-1*normv^2 <= D2V(x)[v,v] <= normv^2 for every x,v.

Finite real complete Hilbert/Borel full space E, including dimension zero; arbitrary measurable parameter space S; actual measurable eta:S->R and y:S->E with eta(s)>0 for every s. These coordinate-free/parameter-space extensions are disclosed. Printed Lemma4.2 inherits eta>0 from Section3.1; the eta<=1 premise of neighboring Lemma4.1 is not consumed.

No supplied proximal point, minimizer, measurable selector, gradient estimate, Lipschitz bound or Markov kernel. All are produced from the literal potential and actual Gaussian pushforward. The source numerical-prox call cap eta<=1/(2beta) remains a separate computational contract. Output first moment and allsigned Laplace domains, including actual mean, are also produced internally.

formulae.label: Actual proximal Gaussian oracle with genuine centered Laplace domain
formulae.tex: F_s(x)=V(x)+\|x-y_s\|^2/(2\eta_s),\quad p_s+\eta_s\nabla V(p_s)=y_s,\quad G(s,z)=\nabla V(p_s+\sqrt{\eta_s}z),\quad K_s=G(s,\cdot)_\#\gamma.\quad m_s=\int w\,dK_s,\quad\mathrm{id}\in L^1(K_s;E),\quad e^{t\langle a,w-m_s\rangle}\in L^1(K_s)\ (a\in E,t\in\mathbb R).
